summary: Comprehensive frontend UI overhaul verification completed on mobile viewport (390x844). All 24 acceptance criteria pass: dark-navy/amber theme, header stats (Total Setor Rp 52.000, Titip 28, Sisa 10) computed correctly from seed data, tab navigation Daftar Barang/Rekap Setoran, search + 3 filter chips (Semua/Bu Siti/Pak Joko), penitip cards with avatar/WA/edit/delete, dual photo slots (SEBELUM blue / SISA red) with placeholder camera icon, metric pills (Titip/Sisa/Terjual), setor formula verified (Keripik Singkong (3-1)*1000 = Rp 2.000), dark group footer with Teks + Kirim Foto Rekap buttons, FAB add flow with multi-item form (capture-sebelum-0 + capture-sisa-0 testIDs present), camera buttons do not crash on web preview (expected; sharing shows friendly 'Gagal berbagi rekap' toast on web), live preview Terjual/Setor updates while typing, Tambah Item Lainnya adds row, Simpan Titipan persists new penitip, edit button opens modal with pre-filled fields, delete opens delete-confirm-modal with Batal/Hapus buttons, Rekap Setoran tab shows recap cards with Sebelum+Sisa thumbnails and share buttons, toast notifications appear on success (Penitipan berhasil ditambahkan / Data penitip berhasil dihapus) and error (Gagal berbagi rekap), AsyncStorage persistence verified across page reload, filter chips do NOT overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390). No red-screen errors, no PAGEERROR events, no deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch not used).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 2357 lines — main agent should consider splitting into modules (ConsignmentCard, RecapCard, ItemFormModal, DeleteConfirmModal, hooks) for maintainability, though it's not blocking functionality.

Minor: React Native Web console warnings about deprecated shadow* style props ('shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'). Not blocking but should migrate to boxShadow to silence warnings on web preview.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Bu Persist / TEST Keripik via UI to validate AsyncStorage persistence + delete flow; cleaned up via delete-confirm. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI overhaul features verified end-to-end on mobile viewport. testIDs are stable and comprehensive (capture-sebelum-{i}, capture-sisa-{i}, input-{field}-{i}, group-card-{i}, edit-group-{id}, delete-group-{id}, delete-confirm-modal, recap-share-text-{id}, recap-share-all-{id}, toast). Camera and native share are correctly gated on web preview — they show friendly error toast instead of crashing, which is the desired behavior. On real device build, expo-image-picker.launchCameraAsync + react-native-view-shot + expo-sharing will invoke native camera and WhatsApp attachment sheet.
